label: miso 44 wefor neutral
definition: miso-44: miso-42 recipe + wefor_multiplier neutralized 0.7→1.0 (DOF reduction, audit C-15). Root-cause: the miso-42 ablation twin scored better because wefor=0.7 was silently subsidizing CC availability (lowering thermal EFOR 30%), not because the reliability floors were harmful. Neutralizing wefor halves the CC over-run (+44→+20 TWh) and improves prices (C3a from -15.6→PASS in 2024). Reliability floors KEPT (all structurally sound, <0.6 TWh total forced). 6 residual-identified DOFs (vs miso-42's 7).
market_story: DOF reduction from miso-42: wefor_multiplier removed (0.7→1.0). The 0.7 haircut had no measured physical basis (audit C-15: scales THERMAL EFOR, not wind); root-cause of the miso-42 ablation-twin advantage was the twin's wefor neutralization, not its floor removal. With physical EFOR restored: CC_REGULAR drops from +44/+43 to +20/+19 TWh (2023/24), CT_PEAKER recovers to PASS, C3a price-mean 2024 recovers to PASS, C3b price-shape 2025 recovers to PASS. Coal 2025 over-run worsens (+8.8%→+14.7%) as reduced CC availability shifts marginal load to coal — a known commitment-posture artifact. All reliability floor limbs retained (MISO-Indiana CT_PEAKER evening [15,21), MISO-Indiana COAL tmax, MISO-Plains ST_GAS tmax, MISO-South COAL tmax); forced energy <0.4% of any class (D-2 PASS). Legitimacy diagnostics Overall PASS.
